rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for honesty, integrity, and trustworthiness.

example.english: I place great importance on having honesty.
example.traditional: 我好重視做人要有誠信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung6 si6 zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 sing4 seon3

rows.note: Use this for the slice of honesty that means frank, open self-expression rather than general moral integrity.

example.english: You can speak frankly and show your honesty.
example.traditional: 你可以坦率咁講出自己嘅感受。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 taan2 seot1 gam3 gong2 ceot1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6
